description: This file contains functions and data related to generating block differences for OTA updates in an Android build system. It manages user image partitions, retrieves images, and computes differences for full and incremental OTA packages.

methods.name: GetUserImages
methods.description: Retrieves user images for specified partitions if the image files exist.

methods.name: FullOTA_GetBlockDifferences
methods.description: Computes block differences for a full OTA update based on current images.

methods.name: IncrementalOTA_GetBlockDifferences
methods.description: Computes block differences for an incremental OTA update based on source and target images.
